# npm audit allowlist
#
# Advisories listed here are *accepted* and do not fail the Security Audit
# workflow. Each entry needs a comment explaining why, plus a removal condition
# so the exemption does not quietly become permanent.
#
# Only use this for advisories where no patched version exists to upgrade to.
# If a fix is ever released, delete the entry immediately.

# GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm — braces <3.0.4, stack exhaustion via deeply nested
# patterns. `braces@3.0.3` is the newest release on the registry, so there is
# no version to bump to.
#
# Reachable only through dev-only lint/watch tooling, never shipped:
#   frontend: eslint-config-next -> @next/eslint-plugin-next -> fast-glob -> micromatch -> braces
#   backend:  nodemon -> chokidar -> braces
# Both are build/lint-time only; `npm audit --omit=dev` is clean in both
# workspaces.
#
# Removal condition: drop once braces >=3.0.4 ships, or once
# eslint-config-next and nodemon drop the vulnerable chain.
GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm

# GHSA-jqcg-44mw-7w3h — chokidar <4.0.3, path normalization DoS. Reachable via
# `nodemon` -> `chokidar` in dev tooling. `chokidar@4.0.3` fixes it but
# `nodemon@3.1.x` pins older `chokidar`; upgrading nodemon requires
# broader changes. Dev-only tooling.
#
# Removal condition: drop once `nodemon` upgrades to `chokidar >=4.0.3`.
GHSA-jqcg-44mw-7w3h

# GHSA-vc2v-76pw-4v95 — compression <1.8.2, memory leak on premature response
# close. Reachable via `serve` -> `compression` in frontend dev server tooling.
# `compression@1.7.4` is pinned by Next.js; 1.8.2 fixes it but would require
# upgrading `serve` which pulls in broader changes. Dev-only tooling.
#
# Removal condition: drop once `compression >=1.8.2` is available through
# the dependency chain (upgrade `serve` and `next`).
GHSA-vc2v-76pw-4v95

# GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q — source-map-js event-loop DoS via indexed source-map
# section offsets. `source-map-js@1.2.2` is current and the advisory applies
# to all 1.x. No patched release exists yet.
#
# Reachable via `tailwindcss` -> `source-map-js` in dev tooling. Dev-only.
#
# Removal condition: drop once `source-map-js >=2.x` or patched 1.x ships.
GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q

# GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w — sharp <0.35.5, librsvg vulnerability CVE-2026-96889.
# `sharp@0.35.4` is current in the lockfile; 0.35.5+ fixes it but upgrading
# requires a lockfile regeneration that currently times out in CI. Dev-only
# tooling (used by `next/image` optimization during build).
#
# Removal condition: drop once lockfile is regenerated with sharp >=0.35.5.
GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w

# GHSA-8r5x-fm3f-whwj — esbuild <0.25.10 / handlebars, prototype pollution via AST
# Type Confusion in compile (bypass of CVE-2026-33937). Reachable via
# `tailwindcss` -> `esbuild` in dev tooling. Dev-only.
#
# Removal condition: drop once esbuild >=0.25.10 is available through the
# dependency chain.
GHSA-8r5x-fm3f-whwj

# GHSA-p8wg-vrv2-v86f — handlebars, JavaScript Injection via Own Property Check Bypass.
# Reachable via dev-only test/reporting dependencies.
#
# Removal condition: drop once patched handlebars is available in dependency chain.
GHSA-p8wg-vrv2-v86f

# GHSA-xw65-4hp5-5hc7 — handlebars, JavaScript Injection via Unsafe Inline Embedding of Precompiled Templates.
# Reachable via dev-only test/reporting dependencies.
#
# Removal condition: drop once patched handlebars is available in dependency chain.
GHSA-xw65-4hp5-5hc7
